description: Docksy safety net: always ask before a destructive Docksy action (delete an app, delete a server, restore a backup), even in auto mode.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Docksy: this action is destructive and cannot be undone (delete app, delete server or restore backup). Check the target, then confirm."}}'
